title: Merge intervals
skill: List the edge cases and the error message

good: Fix merge(intervals) in src/intervals.js. Each interval is [start, end]. Rules: 1) return the result sorted by start; 2) overlapping intervals become one; 3) touching ones too: [1, 2] and [2, 3] give [1, 3] (use <=); 4) the merged end is the max of the ends, so [1, 10] and [2, 3] give [1, 10]; 5) before merging, an interval with start > end throws RangeError with the message `bad interval [5, 1]` (its own numbers); 6) start == end is valid; 7) [] gives []; 8) never change the input array or its inner arrays (tests freeze them), and return new arrays. Do not change other files. Then run: node --test test/*.test.js
lazy: merge() for calendar intervals has bugs. Fix them.
